facts.value: knocking out the other 2 enemies first

facts.subject: Cure Potion
facts.text: Cure Potions can be bought at Aquaria Inn, Fireburg Inn, and Windia Inn, or picked up at Kaeli's house in Foresta.

evidence.quote:
Location: Can be found just about anywhere and bought at Aquaria Inn,
Fireburg Inn, and Windia Inn. To be cheap, you can go in and out of
Foresta picking up the Cure Potions at Kaeli's house.

facts.subject: Heal Potion
facts.text: Heal Potions can be obtained by going in and out of the Level Forest.

evidence.quote:
Location: These can be found just about anywhere.  If you want to be
cheap you can go in and out of the Level Forest getting these.

facts.subject: Refresher
facts.text: In Aquaria Refreshers are in a house in the back, and in Fireburg they are at Rueben's House.

evidence.quote:
In Aquaria there are in a house in the back and in Fireburg
they are at Rueben's House.

facts.subject: Seeds
facts.text: The best place to get Seeds is to buy them at Fireburg Inn.

evidence.quote:
Location: The best place to get these is to buy them at Fireburg
Inn.  I suggest buying alot because these are the best items in the
game (IMO).

facts.subject: Captain Cap
facts.text: After you bomb Spencer's Place, go to Otto's house and talk to Kaeli to receive the Captain Cap to give to Captain Mac.

evidence.quote:
Name: Captain Cap
Effect: Given to Captain Mac
Location: After you bomb Spencer's Place, go to Otto's house and talk
to Kaeli.

facts.subject: Elixer
facts.text: The Elixer, which saves Kaeli's life, is received from Tristam after beating Flamerus Rex in the Bone Dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Name: Elixer
Effect: Saves Kaeli's Life
Location: Recieved from Tristam after beating Flamerus Rex in the
Bone Dungeon.

facts.subject: Thunder Rock
facts.text: Go to Rueben's House at Fireburg after beating Pazuzu, where a person in a bed will give you the Thunder Rock to give to Otto at Windia.

evidence.quote:
Name: Thunder Rock
Effect: Give to Otto at Windia
Location: Go to Rueben's House at Fireburg.  When you enter there
should be a person in a bed.  He will give you the Rock.  This event
will only happen once you beat Pazuzu.

facts.subject: Tree Wither
facts.text: Push the boulder blocking the old man's way at Level Forest to get the Tree Wither, which gets Kaeli to join your party.

evidence.quote:
Name: Tree Wither
Effect: Gets Kaeli to join your party
Location: Push the boulder blocking the old man's way at Level
Forest.

facts.subject: Wakewater
facts.text: Enter the Libra Temple and transport on the crest sign to the Life Temple, then talk to the cloaked man to receive the Wakewater.

evidence.quote:
Name: Wakewater
Effect: Use on plant in the middle of Aquaria
Location: Enter the Libra Temple and transport on the crest sign to
the Life Temple. Just talk to the cloaked man to receive the item.

facts.subject: Multi-Key
facts.text: After getting Reuben in your party, try to open the building in the middle of the town, then go back to Rueben's house and talk to Tristam to get the Multi-Key.

evidence.quote:
Name: Multi-Key
Effect: Opens a door in Fireburg
Location: After you get Reuben in your party, try to open the
building in the middle of the town. After you try to do that, go back
to Rueben's house and talk to Tristam.  He will give you this key.

facts.subject: Venus Key
facts.text: Enter Aquaria, go under the building into Spencer's Place, and follow the path to reach Spencer, who hands over the Venus Key to open a chest in Focus Tower.

evidence.quote:
Name: Venus Key
Effect: Opens a chest in Focus Tower
Location: Enter Aquaria and go in the water to go under the building
in the bottom left hand corner.  When you enter the building you will
be in Spencer's Place.  There is only one way you can go, so just
follow the path to reach Spencer.  When you talk to him he will hand
over the key.

facts.subject: Magic Mirror
facts.text: At the Ice Pyramid, use the sword against the moving statue to open a door, walk right, down, right, straight up past a gray desert hag, and right past a Lamia to open the chest with the Magic Mirror.

evidence.quote:
Name: Magic Mirror...Location: At the Ice Pyramid, first use the sword against the moving
statue which will open a door.  Go through the door and immediately
walk right.  Now walk all the way down and then all the way right.
Go straight up and you should be near a fight with a gray desert hag.
After that fight go right to get in a fight with a Lamia and after
you defeat her just go right and open the chest.

Take the path
farthest to the right; You'll fight a few enemies you can't see yet, but
near the wll, at the end of the path is the Magic Mirror. Now you can
see the enemies!

Then go right, and you can get the Magic Mirror. This allows you to
see invisible enemies in the Ice Pyramid.

facts.subject: Mask
facts.text: At the Volcano entrance, navigate past the Ghost, Red Bone, hole in the wall, and upper stairs, then beat the ghost and wolf to get the Mask.

evidence.quote:
Name: Mask...Location: At the Volcano entrance, move to the left defeat a Ghost
and go up the stairs.  Jump across the ledge and fight the Red Bone.
Keep fighting all the enemies in the path to go up to the next level.
Go to the left and down the steps.  Keep following the path until you
reach a hole in the wall.  Follow the invisible path to be let out
near a brown chest with heal potions.  Keep following the path to the
right and go up to the next level.  After you go up the stairs go to
the left and follow the path to go up another flight of stairs.  Now,
beat the ghost to your immediate left and then the wolf behind him.
After you beat the wolf, you can now get the Mask.
Another dungeon with poor visibility and invisible enemies. This can be remedied by finding the Mask within the dungeon.

facts.subject: Libra Crest
facts.text: The Libra Crest is received after beating Squidite at the Wintry Cave, activating Libra warp pads.

evidence.quote:
Name: Libra Crest
Effect: Activates Libra warp pads
Location: Received after beating Squidite at the Wintry Cave

After you defeat Squidite, a chest will appear where he once stood. 
Inside, is the Libra Crest! Take the crest, and you're ready to leave 
Wintry Cave.

facts.subject: Gemini Crest
facts.text: From Focus Tower to Fireburg, the middle battlefield of the 3 battlefields in a row contains the Gemini Crest, which activates Gemini warp pads.

evidence.quote:
Name: Gemini Crest
Effect: Activates Gemini warp pads
Location: From Focus Tower to Fireburg, there are 3 battlefields in a
row.  The middle battlefield contains the crest.

facts.subject: Mobius Crest
facts.text: After Reuben bombs Spencer's Place to free the ship, drop in the water, climb up north, bomb the door, then return to the entrance, head left, jump the square, and go north through the cave and crest to reach the chest with the Mobius Crest.

evidence.quote:
Name: Mobius Crest...Location: After Reuben bombs Spencer's Place to free the ship, you
can get this crest.  First you must go to the right and up to reach
somewhere where you can drop in the water.  Once you are in the
water, just go all the way left and go up.  You will find another
place where you can climb up.  Go all the way north on this platform
and bomb the door so you can get through.  Now go back to the
enterance and go left this time. Jump over the square and go north
through the cave just left of the crest marking.  Go through the
crest that looks like a headband and you can now reach the chest with
the mobius crest.

facts.subject: River Coin
facts.text: The River Coin opens a door at Focus Tower and is received after beating Ice Golem at the Ice Pyramid.

evidence.quote:
Name: River Coin
Effect: Opens a door at Focus Tower
Location: Received after beating Ice Golem at the Ice Pyramid

Get the River
Coin from the treasure chest, and then, leave the Ice Pyramid

Now, you have restored the Crystal of Water. Yay! 2 down, 2 to go! Get the
River Coin and then leave.

facts.subject: Sand Coin
facts.text: The Sand Coin opens a door at Focus Tower and is received after beating Flamerus Rex at the Bone Dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Name: Sand Coin
Effect: Opens a door at Focus Tower
Location: Received after beating Flamerus Rex at the Bone Dungeon
Be sure to open the last three for some Cure Potions, more Explosives, and the Sand Coin.

facts.subject: Sky Coin
facts.text: The Sky Coin opens a door at Focus Tower and is received after beating Pazuzu at Pazuzu's Tower.

evidence.quote:
Name: Sky Coin
Effect: Opens a door at Focus Tower
Location: Received after beating Pazuzu at Pazuzu's Tower

facts.subject: Sun Coin
facts.text: The Sun Coin opens a door at Focus Tower and is received after beating Dualhead Hydra at the Lava Dome.

evidence.quote:
Name: Sun Coin
Effect: Opens a door at Focus Tower
Location: Received after beating Dualhead Hydra at the Lava Dome.

facts.subject: Cure
facts.text: The Cure spell is found at Foresta in the top right tree around the back entrance.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Cure
Effect: Restores HP to one or all targets
Location: Found at Foresta in the top right tree around the back 
entrance.
Inside the chest is your first spell: Cure. It heals HP.
* Cure - Found in a chest in Foresta

facts.subject: Exit
facts.text: Go to the battlefield north of Libra Temple and clear out the battlefield to win the Exit spell.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Exit...Location: Go to the battlefield north of Libra Temple. Clear out the 
battlefield to win the prize.

facts.subject: Heal
facts.text: The Heal spell is next to the boss, Snow Crab, at Falls Basin.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Heal
Effect: Cures any abnormal statuses
Location: The spell is next to the boss, Snow Crab, at Falls Basin.

facts.subject: Life
facts.text: At the Lava Dome, defeat the monster, go down to defeat the Ninja, enter the cave, and follow the path to the monster guarding the Life spell.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Life...Location: At the Lava Dome, go to the right and defeat the monster.
After you win, go down to the next platform and defeat the Ninja.
Keep going down the stairs to enter a cave.  Head to the right and 
follow the path to another monster which is guarding the spell.
Life - Found in a chest in Lava Dome

facts.subject: Aero
facts.text: Go through the purple door in the Focus Tower and go down the first stairs to enter Doom Castle, defeating the enemy in your way for the Aero spell chest.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Aero
Effect: A wind attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Go through the purple door in the Focus Tower and go down
the first set of stairs to enter Doom Castle. Defeat the one enemy in
your way for the chest.

facts.subject: Blizzard
facts.text: Open the door in the Focus Tower with the Venus Key to find the Blizzard spell on the left side of the room.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Blizzard
Effect: An ice attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Open the door in the focus tower with the Venus Key and
find the Blizzard spell on the left side of the room at the Focus 
Tower.
* Blizzard - Found in a chest in Focus Tower 2F

facts.subject: Fire
facts.text: Enter the Focus Tower, go through the one-wall block of wall and up the stairs, open the orange door, go up the stairs, and head south to reach the Fire spell chest.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Fire
Effect: A fire attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Enter the focus tower, and when you see a one-wall block of
wall go through it and up the stairs.  Open the orange door and go up
until you can go up some stairs.  Now go south until you reach the
chest.
* Fire - Found in a chest in Focus Tower 2F

facts.subject: Quake
facts.text: At Bone Dungeon, walk through the break to the left in the ribs wall and follow the path defeating monsters to reach the Quake spell chest.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Quake
Effect: An earth attack that damages all targets
Location: At Bone Dungeon, later in the stage you will be traveling
through a set of ribs once you enter the room.  Midway through the
structure there is a little break to the left in the wall where you
can walk through the bones.  Follow the path and defeat the monsters
along the way to reach the chest.
Go up first. The Quake spell can be found in here.
* Quake - Found in a chest in Bone Dungeon B2

facts.subject: Flare
facts.text: The Flare spell is on the 5th floor of Pazuzu's Tower, reached by coming down from the stairs on the 6th floor.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Flare
Effect: Strong fire attack that damages all targets
Location: It is on the 5th floor of Pazuzu's Tower.  You have to come
down from the stairs on the 6th floor to reach it.

facts.subject: Meteor
facts.text: At the Giant Tree on the second floor, go down 4 steps, right, down, through the door, up 2 and left 1, cut down the mushroom with your axe, and follow the small path on the bottom to reach the Meteor spell chest.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Meteor...Location: At the Giant Tree, go to the second floor.  Once you reach
this floor go down 4 steps then all the way right then all the way
down.  Keep going right and down to reach the door.  When you enter
go up 2 and left 1 and cut down the mushroom in front of you with
your axe.  Make sure you go down the small path on the bottom of your
screen.  Follow this path around and defeat the monsters on the path
to reach the chest.

facts.subject: Thunder
facts.text: Go to the second battlefield west of Fireburg and clear out the battlefield to win the Thunder spell.

evidence.quote:
Spell: Thunder
Effect: Strong electric attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Go to the second battlefield west of Fireburg.  Clear out
the battlefield to win the prize.

facts.subject: White
facts.text: Enter the Volcano, go up the stairs to the right, fight the wolf, go through the door, and walk left through the other door to reach the chest with the White spell.

evidence.quote:
Spell: White
Effect: Strong attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Enter the Volcano and go up the stairs to the right.  At
the top, fight the wolf and go through the door.  Walk to the left
and when you come out the other door you are at the chest with the
White - Found in a chest in the Volcano

facts.subject: Steel Helm
facts.text: Buy the Steel Helm, with 4 Defense, from the house where a woman sells it at the back of Aquaria.

evidence.quote:
Name: Steel Helm
Defense: 4
Protection: Nothing
Location: Buy it in Aquaria.  The house that the woman sells it is at
the back of the town.

facts.subject: Moon Helm
facts.text: At Lava Dome, head left, go up the stairs defeating a Ninja, defeat another Ninja into a cave, and head right and to the top of the room to find the Moon Helm chest with 9 Defense and Fire protection.

evidence.quote:
Name: Moon Helm
Defense: 9
Protection: Fire
Location: When you enter Lava Dome start heading to the left and take 
the stairs and defeat the Ninja at the top. Keep going left fighting 
another Ninja along the way until you can enter a cave. Go to the 
right and head to the top of the room.  Stay on the path and you will 
eventually reach the chest with the helm.
Moon Helm - Found in  chest in Lava Dome

facts.subject: Apollo Helm
facts.text: At Mount Gale, walk left along the north part of the long brown bridge, grapple to a platform, and defeat the Vampire guarding the chest for the Apollo Helm with 15 Defense and Fire protection.

evidence.quote:
Name: Apollo Helm
Defense: 15
Protection: Fire
Location:  At Mount Gale, keep going until you reach a long brown
bridge that branches off in a couple directions. Head to the north
part of the bridge then start walking to the left.  Defeat the
monsters along the way and then grapple to a platform. Defeat the
Vampire that is guarding the chest.
Apollo Helm - Found in a chest in Mount Gale

facts.subject: Steel Armor
facts.text: Steel Armor is the initial armor with 6 Defense and no protection.

evidence.quote:
Name: Steel Armor
Defense: 6
Protection: Nothing
Location: Initial Armor

facts.subject: Noble Armor
facts.text: Noble Armor has 12 Defense and Water and Poison protection, located at Ice Pyramid.

evidence.quote:
Name: Noble Armor
Defense: 12
Protection: Water, Poison
Location: At Ice Pyramid.

facts.subject: Gaia's Armor
facts.text: Gaia's Armor has 15 Defense and Water, Wind, Sleep, and Poison protection, located at Mac's Ship.

evidence.quote:
Name: Gaia's Armor
Defense: 15
Protection: Water, Wind, Sleep, Poison
Location: At Mac's Ship.

facts.subject: Steel Shield
facts.text: After buying bombs from Tristam at Bone Dungeon, backtrack to the 2nd room of the dungeon and bomb the wall for the Steel Shield with 5 Defense.

evidence.quote:
Name: Steel Shield
Defense: 5
Protection: Nothing
Location: After buying the bombs from Tristam at Bone Dungeon, you
can backtrack to the 2nd room of the dungeon and bomb the wall there
for this shield.
A bit to your north is a skull. Blow it out of the way with your newly acquired bomb. Past it is a Steel Shield.
* Steel Shield **(Missable)** - Found in a chest in Bone Dungeon B1 (Can no longer be obtained after getting Jumbo Bombs in the next section)

facts.subject: Venus Shield
facts.text: Open a locked door in the Focus Tower with the Venus Key to get the Venus Shield with 10 Defense and Paralyze protection.

evidence.quote:
Name: Venus Shield
Defense: 10
Protection: Paralyze
Location: Open a locked door in the focus tower with the Venus Key.

2F: Use a bomb on the door and open the chest using the Venus Key to get the
Venus Shield.
* Venus Shield - Found in a chest in Focus Tower 2F
You can also get both the Venus Shield and the Blizzard Spell during the visit.

facts.subject: Aegis Shield
facts.text: At Doom Castle, go west, up, and right down the stairs to the sand pit, bomb the fossils, and defeat the monster guarding the chest for the Aegis Shield with 14 Defense and Paralyze and Stone protection.

evidence.quote:
Name: Aegis Shield
Defense: 14
Protection: Paralyze, Stone
Location: At Doom Castle, go all the way west then up from the
enterance.  Once you get to the top go all the way to the right to
the last set of stairs going down to the sand pit.  Go down these
stairs and travel down the sand until you reach some fossils.  Bomb
the fossils and defeat the monster guarding the chest.

facts.subject: Charm
facts.text: Clear out the battlefield left of Bone Dungeon to win the Charm accessory with 1 Defense.

evidence.quote:
Name: Charm
Defense: 1
Protection: Nothing
Location: Head to the battlefield left of Bone Dungeon.  Clear out
the battlefield to win this prize.

facts.subject: Magic Ring
facts.text: Clear out the battlefield directly left of Aquaria to win the Magic Ring with 3 Defense and Silence protection.

evidence.quote:
Name: Magic Ring
Defense: 3
Protection: Silence
Location: Head to the battlefield that is directly left of Aquaria.
Clear out the battlefield to win this prize.

facts.subject: Cupid Locket
facts.text: At Windia, go to the house on your immediate left and talk to the girl to buy the Cupid Locket with 6 Defense and Silence, Blind, and Confusion protection.

evidence.quote:
Name: Cupid Locket
Defense: 6
Protection: Silence, Blind, Confusion
Location: At Windia, go to the house on your immediate left and talk
to the girl and buy it from her.

facts.subject: Weapons
facts.text: Each weapon except bombs raises around 2.5 attack power per level from level 1 based attack values, while bombs are strongest initially but weakest by level 32.

evidence.quote:
Each weapon, except bombs, raises in attack power when you increase a
level. I think it is around 2.5 more attack per level.  All attack
values are level 1 based. Bombs are generally the strongest weapon
when you initially get them, but by the time you reach level 32 they
will be your weakest.

facts.subject: Steel Sword
facts.text: The Steel Sword is the initial weapon with 12 Attack and no status effects.

evidence.quote:
Name: Steel Sword
Attack: 12
Status effects: Nothing
Location: Initial Weapon

facts.subject: Knight Sword
facts.text: At the Ice Pyramid, bomb a breakable section on the map to fall through the hole into a room of chests, one of which contains the Knight Sword with 54 Attack.

evidence.quote:
Name: Knight Sword
Attack: 54
Status effects: Nothing
Location: At the Ice Pyramid, a while through the dungeon you will
have to bomb a little breakable section on the map.  When you fall
through this hole you will be surrounded by chests, one of which is
the sword.

Stab one of the statues, to open the floor, and jump
down again. You'll be completely surrounded by enemies, and chests....The chests contain Arrows, Potions, Heal Potions, and most importantly,
in the fancy chest, the Knight Sword!

1F: Poke any of these statues, and then fall.

B1: Go down, and get the Knight Sword.

facts.subject: Excalibur
facts.text: Excalibur has 134 Attack and is at Pazuzu's Tower on the 3rd or 4th floor, reached by climbing up the tower and heading down another path.

evidence.quote:
Name: Excalibur
Attack: 134
Status effects: Nothing
Location: It is at Pazuzu's Tower on the 3rd or 4th floor.  You first
have to climb up the tower and then start making your way down
another path to be able to reach this chest.

facts.subject: Axe
facts.text: Kaeli gives you the Axe, which has 16 Attack.

evidence.quote:
Name: Axe
Attack: 16
Status effects: Nothing
Location: Kaeli gives it to you.

facts.subject: Battle Axe
facts.text: A woman sells the Battle Axe with 69 Attack in her house in the south part of Fireburg.

evidence.quote:
Name: Battle Axe
Attack: 69
Status effects: Nothing
Location: A women sells it in Fireburg.  Her house is in the south
part of the town.
A woman will sell you a Battle Axe for 500 GP.
Battle Axe - Bought in Fireburg

facts.subject: Giant's Axe
facts.text: In the Alive Forest where the giant tree is, head left and cut down trees heading south to reach a chest at another big tree containing the Giant's Axe with 102 Attack.

evidence.quote:
Name: Giant's Axe
Attack: 102
Status effects: Nothing
Location: In the Alive Forest where the giant tree is, head left and
cut down the trees while heading south.  Once you reach another big
tree you should see a chest.  Make your way to it and get the axe.
Giant's Axe - Found in a chest in Alive Forest

facts.subject: Cat Claw
facts.text: Phoebe gives you the Cat Claw with 9 Attack and Poison and Paralyze status effects when you slip and fall in the Wintry Cave.

evidence.quote:
Name: Cat Claw
Attack: 9
Status effects: Poison, Paralyze
Location: Phoebe gives it to you when you slip and fall in the Wintry
Cave.
* Cat Claw - Given by Phoebe in the Wintry Cave

facts.subject: Charm Claw
facts.text: In the mine, take the belt going up past the skeleton, ride the right belt, take the bucket down, and take the right path inside the cave to reach the Charm Claw chest with 44 Attack.

evidence.quote:
Name: Charm Claw
Attack: 44
Status effects: Poison, Paralyze, Sleep, Confusion, Blind
Location: When you enter the mine take the belt going up.  Fight the
skeleton at the top and then go to the right and take another belt.
Once you get off the belt you should see a bucket you can enter to go
down.  To your left you should see some skeletons blocking an
entrance which you will want access too. Take the right path inside
this cave to reach the chest.
Charm Claw - Found in a chest in the Mine

facts.subject: Dragon Claw
facts.text: After finishing the Alive Forest, return to Spencer's Place in Aquaria, follow the path down to the 2nd screen, and talk to Tristam to receive the Dragon Claw with 87 Attack.

evidence.quote:
Name: Dragon Claw
Attack: 87
Status effects: Poison, Paralyze, Sleep, Confusion, Blind, Stone,
Silence
Location: Once you finish going through the Alive Forest, go back to
Aquaria.  Go back into Spencer's Place and follow the path all the
way down to the 2nd screen.  Tristam will give you the claw when you
talk to the man on this screen.

facts.subject: Bomb
facts.text: Buy Bomb with 63 Attack from Tristam when you enter Bone Dungeon, saying no the first time to buy them for a cheaper price.

evidence.quote:
Name: Bomb
Attack: 63
Status effects: Nothing
Location: Buy them from Tristam when you enter Bone Dungeon. Say no
the first time if you want to buy them for a cheaper price.

facts.subject: Jumbo Bomb
facts.text: Phoebe will give you Jumbo Bomb with 112 Attack when you beat the Snow Crab at Falls Basin.

evidence.quote:
Name: Jumbo Bomb
Attack: 112
Status effects: Nothing
Location: Phoebe will give them to you when you beat the Snow Crab at
Falls Basin.
* Jumbo Bomb - Given by Phoebe in Falls Basin

facts.subject: Mega Grenade
facts.text: After getting the multi-key, go in the building in the middle of Fireburg and talk to the guy to receive the Mega Grenade with 162 Attack.

evidence.quote:
Name: Mega Grenade
Attack: 162
Status effects: Nothing
Location: After you get the multi-key, go in the building in the
middle of Fireburg.  Talk to the guy to receive the bombs.
Mega Grenade - Found in a house in Fireburg

facts.subject: Bomb
facts.text: Bombs can be bought at Aquaria Inn or obtained from the only brown chest at Libra Temple.

evidence.quote:
d) Bomb (Can be bought at Aquaria Inn or found in various places.  An
easy way to get them from the only brown chest at Libra Temple.)

facts.subject: Focus Tower
facts.text: Focus Tower lies in the center of the world where the four main regions meet.

evidence.quote:
This world is divided into four main regions. In the center of the world,
where they meet, lies Focus Tower.

facts.subject: Benjamin
facts.text: Benjamin flees to the Hill of Destiny following a mysterious cloaked man after his village is destroyed by a quake, which is where the game opens up.

evidence.quote:
Benjamin (aka Hero) lived in a village near the Hill of Destiny. His 
village was destroyed by one of these Quakes, and he fled to the Hill of
Destiny, following a mysteriosu cloaked man. This is where the game 
opens up.

facts.subject: Out of Battle Controls
facts.text: Pressing A uses your weapon, opens chests, and talks to people out of battle.

evidence.quote: (A)    - Use weapon + Open Chest + Talk to People

facts.subject: Out of Battle Controls
facts.text: Pressing B jumps out of battle.

evidence.quote: (A) - Use weapon + Open Chest + Talk to People (B) - Jump (Y) - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.

facts.subject: Companion Controls
facts.text: Pressing Y switches between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.

evidence.quote: (Y)    - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.

facts.subject: Save Screen
facts.text: Pressing X enters the save screen out of battle.

evidence.quote: (X)    - Enter save screen

facts.subject: Weapon Selection
facts.text: Pressing L or R switches your weapon.

evidence.quote:
(L)    - Switch weapon
(R)    - Switch weapon

facts.subject: Map Screen
facts.text: On the map screen, red arrows indicate an open path you can move to, while grey arrows mean there is still something to do.

evidence.quote:
The area has darknened arrows, or red arrows. If it's red,
you've done what you needed to to open that path, and can move on,
if it's grey, there's still something you haven't done.

facts.subject: Map Screen
facts.text: Clouds on the map disappear as you explore more of the map.

evidence.quote:
Additionally,
there are lots of clouds at the beginning. As you exlpore more of
the map, they'll dissapear.

facts.subject: Message Speed
facts.text: Message speed can be changed between 1 and 7 in the customize menu.

evidence.quote: (Message Speed) - Change speed of messages between 1 & 7.

facts.subject: Life Indicate
facts.text: The Life Indicate option switches between HP bars or numbers.

evidence.quote: (Life Indicate) - Switch between HP bars, or numbers.

facts.subject: Kaeli
facts.text: Kaeli is the first partner you get in the game.

facts.subject: Platform

a paltform. Press B to jump across, and the first platform will sink

facts.subject: Behemoth
facts.text: Behemoth has 80HP, yields 84 EXP and 3 GP, and uses the physical attack Horn.

evidence.quote:
Behemoth  - 80HP          |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 84      | Battle Strategy: This fight isn't hard. You only have|
| GP: 3        | one weapon, and no item or spells though. Keep       |
O--------------O choosing to attack, and he should die. Although, it  |
| Attack List  | is possible to die, if he gets critical hits to much,|
| ===========  | you'll just start the battle over anyway, so don't   |
| Horn         | worry about it. Horn is just a physical attack.
This area is linear and just consists of some exposition and a boss fight against a Behemoth. Not much to do here besides attack until it's dead and move on.

facts.subject: Hill of Destiny
facts.text: After defeating Behemoth, a quake wipes Hill of Destiny off the map and the cloaked figure tells Hero to meet him in Level Forest.

evidence.quote:
After you defeat Behemoth, another Quake will start. The cloaked figure
will tell you to meet him in Level Forest. Hero leaves, automatically,
as a quake whipes Hill of Destiny off the map. You only have one 
destination on the map - Level Forest.

facts.subject: Man in blue robe
facts.text: Push the stone blocking the man in the blue robe to receive a Tree Wither to show to Kaeli.

evidence.quote:
Well, head north, until you see a man in a blue robe. If you talk to him
you'll find out the stone is blocking his path. Jump over him, and push
the stone, and he'l lthank you. He'll also give you a Tree Wither, and
tell you to show it to a girl named Kaeli.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Head left to find a treasure chest containing 3 potions.

evidence.quote: Head left, and you can get 3 potions from the treasure chest.

facts.subject: Level Forest
facts.text: Head all the way to the right after collecting the potion to exit Level Forest and open the path to Foresta.

evidence.quote:
Head all the way to the right after getting the potion, and you'll leave Level 
Forest, and open the path to Foresta.

facts.subject: Kaeli
facts.text: Talking to Kaeli in the first tree home on the left causes her to see the Tree Wither and join the party.

evidence.quote:
When you enter Foresta, head into the first tree home on the left. There
are two girls at the table in this house; The one on the left is Kaeli.
Talk to her, and she'll see the Tree Wither, and volunteer to help you.
Kaeli joins your party!
Kaeli decides to tag along.
Go into the house in the lower right hand corner and talk to Kaeli. After an outstandingly fun scene, she will join your party.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: In the back of Kaeli's house, a treasure chest holds 3 potions.

evidence.quote:
In the back of Kaeli's house, there is a treasure chest with 3 potions
in it.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: The house on the bottom right side of Foresta contains a treasure chest with potions.

evidence.quote:
The house on the right side
of town (the one on the bottom) also has a treasure chest with potions,
if you'd like to get it.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Jump across two logs in the water north of town into the back of a tree home to find a treasure chest containing the Cure spell.

evidence.quote:
Head to the north end of the town, and cross the bridge. On the 
right, in the water, are two logs. Jump across them, to the back of a
tree home. There's a door there, so walk into the house, and there will
be a treasure chest with the Cure spell inside.

facts.subject: Bed
facts.text: Resting in the bed on the left side of the house restores Hero's health.

evidence.quote:
Also, remember, if you
use the bed on the left side of this house, your health will be 
restored.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Treasure chests in Level Forest that look like the potion chest restore when leaving the level.

evidence.quote:
make 
sure to grab thepotion that you got the last time you were here - Chests
that look like this one restore when you leave the level - and you're
good to go.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Defeat the Brownie and Slime on the right to access a chest containing 3 Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
take out the Brownie and the Slime on
the right, to reach a chest with 3 Heal Potions inside.

facts.subject: Minotaur
facts.text: Casting the Life Spell defeats Minotaur in one hit.

evidence.quote:
If you 
want to be cheap, use a Life Spell, to bring him 
down in one hit.

facts.subject: Kaeli
facts.text: After defeating Minotaur, Kaeli leaves the party and gives Hero her axe to cut down trees.

evidence.quote:
After the battle, Kaeli's mom will come, and take Kaeli home. Hero will
volunteer to get the elixer to save Kaili - He's told it's in the Sand
Temple that's a little north. Kaeli will give Hero her axe - You can 
cut trees down now! - and then, they'll leave.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Cut down trees on the south-west section of the map to access a chest containing a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote:
You can access a Brownie and a chest with a Heal Potion by cutting down
trees on the south-west section of the map.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Cut down trees on the south-east to reach a chest with a Potion inside.

evidence.quote:
You can also find a chest 
with a Potion inside it, by cutting down trees on the south-east.

facts.subject: Battlefield
facts.text: Defeating 10 sets of monsters in the battlefield north of Level Forest awards GP, EXP, and 54 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Enemies - Mad Plant + Poison Toad
Reward - 54 EXP
=================

North of Level Forest, right before Sand Temple, is the first
battlefield. Like all future battelfields, it's optional. Fight 10 sets
of monsters, and earn GP and EXP, and sometimes an item.

facts.subject: Tristam
facts.text: Tristam meets Hero at the empty treasure chest in Sand Temple and agrees to accompany him through Bone Dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Walk through the door in the first room, into
second room, and check the one treasure chest there. You'll find it's
empty. Soon, Tristam will come in, and offer to seel you the elixer for
9000 GP... Hero and Tristam will strike a deal though. Tristam will accompany you
through the Bone Dungeon, and he'll give you the Elixer afterwards.... After Tristam joins the party, exit the sand temple.

facts.subject: Battlefield
facts.text: Clearing out the battlefield to the left of Sand Temple awards a Charm armor that increases defense.

evidence.quote:
Before heading to the Bone Dungeon, you really should head left from 
sand Temple, and clear out a battlefield. When you win, you'll pick up
a Charm. The charm is an armor, that will increase your defense, so it's
good to have.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Chests on both the left and right sides of the moving sand each contain 10 Ninja Stars.

evidence.quote:
choose to fight the monsters on either the left or 
right side, to go around the sand - if you do this, there's a chest with
10 Ninja Stars for Tristam, on both sides.

facts.subject: Treasure chest
facts.text: Open the chest at the edge of the moving sand to collect 3 potions.

evidence.quote:
open the 
chest at the edge of the sand, to get 3 potions, and then go through the
set of bones that make up a door.

facts.subject: Tristam
facts.text: Saying Sorry to Tristam after he blows open the door reduces his price for 50 bombs from 30GP to 15GP.

evidence.quote:
Tristam will blow it open with a bomb! He'll then offer to sell you 50
bombs for 30GP. Say "Sorry" and he'll cut the price to 15GP, where you
have no choice but to pay - but that's god, you want those bombs!

evidence.quote:
There's aset of bones lying
on the ground. Use a bomb to blow them up. There's a treasure chest
containing a Steel Shield behind them, and it will boost your defense by
5 points!

On the right side of the next room, is a chest full of bombs, blocked by

choose to fight the monsters on either the left or

Bomb its teeth, to open a path. Go
straight, into the next room, where you can pick up 3 seeds.

On the other side, is another Skull with teeth to bomb.
Head straight, down the bones, and into another room. A chest containing
the Quake spell is here, and you'll want to pick it up!

facts.subject: Battlefield
facts.text: Beat 10 rounds of monsters at battlefields to win prizes or EXP and GP.

Battlefields are places on the world map in which you can fight

How many battlefields are there?

        [A] There are 20 in all.

evidence.quote: Refreshers will regain any stats lost in-battle.

stealing some cure potions from the chest.

Pick
up the 10 bombs and check the gold seal on the wall.

Ascend them to 2F. Turn to your left and head south to reach a

Up ahead is a white tile with an omega symbol on it. Ignore it at the moment.

evidence.quote:
Scorpions are weak against
             Fire, so those are easily vanquished.

facts.subject: inn
facts.text: The inn in Aquaria restores HP for a fee of 95 GP.

evidence.quote:
The inn up ahead can restore your HP and stuff. However, you'll have to pay a

facts.subject: Steel Helmet

evidence.quote:

heading out, check the house behind Phoebe's. The woman will sell you a Steel

Don't forget to pick up the 
Refreshers by the beds.

facts.subject: Phoebe's house

evidence.quote: If you'd like, you can steal some Heal Potions from Phoebe's house.

facts.text: Battlefield Seven contains Edgehogs, Scorpions, and Giant Toads, with a prize of 99 EXP.

Battlefield Seven ~

facts.text: Edgehogs are weak against the Fire spell.

evidence.quote:
Like the Scorpion,
             Edgehogs are weak against the Fire spell.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Taking the left path at the entrance of Wintry Cave leads to a chest containing 10 bombs.

evidence.quote:
Head left first and beat up the 
monsters in your way. The chest contains 10 bombs.

facts.subject: Phoebe
facts.text: Phoebe lets Benjamin use her Cat Claws, which allow climbing walls that have steps.

evidence.quote:
She'll let you use her Cat Claws. With them, you can climb walls, but only if
they have steps.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Climbing the wall to the right after falling leads to Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
A little bit to your right is a climb-
able wall. Pick up the Heal Potions.

facts.subject: chests
facts.text: Blowing up the cracked wall behind the Centaur leads to chests with Cure Potions and Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Inspect the wall behind where he once stood. At one point is a cracked
wall. Yeah, you guessed it. Bomb time!! Blow it up and continue. There are a 
bunch of monsters here. If you want the Cure Potions and Arrows, beat them all
to clear a path to the chests.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest guarded by two monsters to the east contains three Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Continue east to find two monsters
guarding a chest. Take three more Cure Potions from the chest.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest guarded by a Centaur to the south contains Three Refreshers.

evidence.quote:
Keep going south to find a chest. Get the Centaur out of the way first. Three
Refreshers can be found inside.

facts.subject: chests
facts.text: Inside the cracked door, the two chests at the entrance hold three Cure Potions and 10 Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Clear the Edgehog out of the way to 
reveal a cracked door. Place a bomb and blow it to smithereens. Inside is 
another batch of monsters. There are some items here. The two chests you see
at the entrance three Cure Potions and 10 Arrows.

facts.subject: chests
facts.text: Heading southeast in the open room leads to two chests with Heal Potions and Arrows.

evidence.quote:
In the next open section
of this room, you can go northeast to advance or southeast to find two more
chests. Snag the Heal Potions and Arrows.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest near the boss's platform contains Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Clear a way to the
center platform, of which the boss stands upon. The chest nearby contains 
Arrows.

facts.subject: Squidite
facts.text: Squidite fights alongside two Sparnas and is weak to Phoebe's Thunder spell.

evidence.quote:
Squidite 
          starts the battle with two Sparna allies. Phoebe can easily shoot
          them down with her Bow of Grace. Once those are taken care of, you
          can focus on Squidite itself. Use Phoebe's Thunder spell to take
          advantage of Squidite's weakness to that element.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Defeating Squidite reveals a chest containing the Libra Crest.

evidence.quote: Defeating the Squidite will reveal a chest. Open it for the Libra Crest.

facts.subject: Battlefield Eight
facts.text: Battlefield Eight features Desert Hags and rewards a prize of 600 GP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Eight ~
     =---------------=
          Monsters: Desert Hag
          Prize: 600 GP

facts.subject: Desert Hag
facts.text: Desert Hags counter physical attacks that do not kill in one hit and are weak against Fire magic.

evidence.quote:
The problem with Desert Hags is their counter-attack. If you use
             a physical attack (that doesn't kill in one hit), you'll most 
             likely eat a nasty counter-attack. Desert Hags can deal quite a 
             bit of damage if you don't defeat them quickly. Fire magic is 
             your best bet here. Desert Hags are weak against that.

facts.subject: omega tile
facts.text: Stepping on the omega tile in the Libra Temple while holding the Libra Crest brings you to the Life Temple.

evidence.quote:
Now that you have the Libra Crest, stepping on the omega tile will bring you
to the Life Temple.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: Cure Potions can be found in the Life Temple.

evidence.quote:
Don't
forget to pick up the Cure Potions. When ready, return to Aquaria.

facts.subject: strange man
facts.text: The strange man in the Life Temple saves what was left of the Wakewater in a bag.

evidence.quote:
Luckily, he managed to save 
what was left of the Wakewater in a tiny bag.

facts.subject: ice block
facts.text: Move the first ice block nine spaces up, seven spaces to the left, and one space up to bridge the platforms.

evidence.quote:
Move the ice block nine spaces 
up, seven spaces to the left, and one space up. Once you finish that task, it 
should be in-between the two platforms.

Push the ice block four spaces to the right and one space up. Like before, 
this block should act as a stepping stone between the two platforms.

facts.subject: ice block
facts.text: Push the second ice block four spaces to the right and one space up to bridge the gap between platforms.

evidence.quote:
Push the ice block four spaces to the right and one space up. Like before, 
this block should act as a stepping stone between the two platforms.

facts.subject: ice blocks
facts.text: Move the third block four spaces left, one space up, two left, six up, and ten right; push the south block four spaces up, eight right, one down, and three right; re-locate the third block one right, one down, eight right, one up, three right, and one up.

evidence.quote:
With this block, move it
four spaces to the left, one space up, two more spaces to the left, six
spaces up, and ten spaces right. 

Take the other ice block at the south end of the screen. Push it four spaces
up, eight spaces to the right, one space down, and three spaces to the right.
Have it rest right below the last ice block. Re-locate the third ice block.
Push it one square to the right, one square down, eight squares right, one
square up, three more squares to the right, and one square up.

facts.subject: chest
facts.text: A chest past the two ice blocks contains bombs.

evidence.quote:
Hop over the gap and onto the two ice blocks you put into place.
Kill off the Desert Hag and continue. Open the chest for some more bombs.

up ahead but before fighting it, snag the Heal spell from the chest nearby.

evidence.quote:

Go somewhere besides a battle field (for instance, the Bone Dungeon) and get to

where you don't win anything and defeat the last battle.Ê You'll get two level
